# SubPaid - AI-Powered Invoicing for Subcontractors
# https://www.subpaid.com/llms.txt

## What is SubPaid?

SubPaid is an AI-powered invoicing software designed specifically for subcontractors in construction, trades, and service industries. It helps users create invoices instantly from photos, automate payment collection calls, and predict payment timing.

## Company Information

- **Company Name:** SubPaid, Inc.
- **Website:** https://www.subpaid.com
- **Founded:** 2023
- **Headquarters:** San Francisco, CA, USA
- **Industry:** Financial Technology / Construction Technology

## Core Features

### Snap-to-Invoice
Take a photo of your completed work, materials receipt, delivery slip, or handwritten notes. SubPaid's AI instantly extracts all details and generates a professional, itemized invoice in seconds. No manual data entry required.

**Key Benefits:**
- Convert photos to invoices in under 5 seconds
- 99% accuracy on text extraction
- Supports material receipts, work orders, timesheets
- Smart suggestions based on history

### SAM Voice Agent
An AI-powered phone assistant that calls clients on your behalf to follow up on unpaid invoices. SAM is professional, persistent, and available 24/7 to help you get paid faster.

**Key Benefits:**
- Natural, human-like conversations
- Calls at optimal times based on client patterns
- Automatic follow-up scheduling
- Full compliance with TCPA/FDCPA regulations
- 85% first-call resolution rate

### Payment Prophet
Predictive AI that analyzes client payment history and industry patterns to forecast when you'll receive payment. Helps with cash flow planning and identifies at-risk invoices early.

**Key Benefits:**
- 91% prediction accuracy
- 14-day average advance notice
- Client payment reliability scoring
- Cash flow forecasting dashboards
- Early warning alerts for late payments

## Pricing

- **Starter:** $19/month - Unlimited invoices, 50 Snap scans/month, 1 user
- **Pro:** $49/month - All AI features, 100 voice calls/month, 3 users (Most Popular)
- **Business:** $99/month - Unlimited everything, API access, 10 users
- **Enterprise:** Custom pricing for large organizations

All plans include a 14-day free trial. No credit card required.
